calls.title: Howard Schwartz and Ivan Gomez
calls.summary: In a recent meeting, Howard Schwartz, based in St. Louis, and Ivan Gomez, now in Bentonville, explored how GrowthBook could improve Howard's company's online sales strategy, which generates $75-100 million annually. Howard shared his background with TicketNetwork.com and expressed limitations with his current experimentation platform, Fulcrum. Ivan introduced GrowthBook’s warehouse-native features, emphasizing its ability to ensure privacy and provide a single source of truth. They discussed various pricing options, including a free tier and an enterprise plan, and reviewed GrowthBook's demo, which highlighted its experiment analysis interface and metric selection capabilities tailored to Howard's needs. The meeting concluded with action items, including scheduling a follow-up technical call to delve into implementation details.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, GrowthBook, Personalization, Data Warehouse, Visual Editor, Enterprise
